item.tib: bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i skong ba nyams gso rab bskang bdud rtsi chu rgyun
item.coloph: bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i skong ba nyams gso rab bskang bdud rtsi chu rgyun zhes bya ba 'di/ mkhas btsun rnam dag ming can la/ gsang sngags dam tshig gnyen po'i blos bskul te/ chags nyams 'gal 'khrul byang phyir bsam pa dag pas bkod/ 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro bon skyong dang / rjes 'breng mkhas pa'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ de las byung ba'i dge ba gang thob des/ 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa la 'khod par shog/
